answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. What survives to the terrace is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The delta is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the atlas.
